svg.text: I/O handshake crane ↔ infeed conveyor for one pick (times from the twin: fine pos. 3 s, fork 2.18 s, lift 0.5 s)
1 every signal is a level (not a pulse) and is reset by the partner's answer (4-way handshake) – safe after a power loss
2 every wait has a time-out: TransferEnable 5 s, LoadTaken 4 s, PosFree 10 s → ASRSRAW_A7071 I/O handshake timeout
3 the conveyor drive is locked off (STO / contactor) while TransferEnable = 1 – the fork never meets a moving load
4 the light curtain muting is active only during the transfer; a person in the field stops the conveyor (SF9)
5 one transfer = fork out 2.18 s + lift 0.5 s + fork in 2.18 s = 4.87 s (+ 3 s fine positioning) – as lhdTime() in asrscore.js
EXAMPLE – check the AS/RS supplier's documentation
